rule: Every calendar session strictly between an instrument's first and last bar that carries no bar is an UNEXPLAINED_MISSING_RECORD boundary (AGENTS.md §6.3). Rolling features re-warm at each boundary: `feature_gap_boundaries` in src/signal_core/features/engine.py is the single definition, and `trailing_continuous_bars` / `pit_universe.median_turnover_as_of` refuse a window that contains one.
